summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around the compound-semiconductor epitaxy/MOCVD chokepoint. The strongest direct US-listed underfollowed candidate is Veeco Instruments, which sells MOCVD, MBE, ion beam, wet processing, and related process tools into compound semiconductor markets including photonics and power electronics. AXT is not an equipment vendor, but it maps tightly to the same constraint stack through indium phosphide substrates used in optical components and lasers. MKS is a second-order tool-subsystem supplier: less pure to MOCVD, but relevant through vacuum, flow, gas delivery, power, and process-control subsystems used across semiconductor production tools. Coherent is included as a high-attention reference/customer-side anchor because its laser and optical-component demand can validate upstream substrate and epitaxy-tool constraints. Non-US-listed Aixtron appears highly relevant to the exact MOCVD tool layer, but is recorded as a coverage gap rather than a candidate because this pass asks for US-listed companies.
